column3: Appoint the owner; fill the AI System Inventory Template; decide your role per system; list applicable laws per market
Fill the AI Risk Register Template for production systems; screen prohibited practices; classify EU AI Act risk
Write a two-page AI policy (acceptable use, approval, oversight, vendor rules); set review cadence; run an incident tabletop with the AI Incident Response Checklist
Assemble the evidence pack (inventory, register, policy, tests, approvals); complete the EU AI Act Readiness Checklist gaps list; plan the next quarter
Leadership review: risks accepted, budget for gaps, owners confirmed, next review date set
